name: iCloud Calendar
description: Your iCloud calendars over CalDAV: list them, read events in a date range, and add an event. An example of an http adapter speaking WebDAV (PROPFIND, REPORT, PUT) with a kept credential: Valet adds your Apple ID and app-specific password to each request, and the tool code never sees them.

icloud.description: Your Apple ID and an app-specific password for iCloud (appleid.apple.com, Sign-In and Security, App-Specific Passwords)

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.title: List calendars
tools.description: Your iCloud calendars that hold events: each one's id, name and colour. Also names the iCloud server your account is on.

tools.name: list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: Events between two dates (at most 62 days apart), from one calendar or all of them: each one's title, start, end and location.

tools.name: add_event
tools.title: Add event
tools.description: Adds an event to one of your calendars: a title, a start and end time (UTC), and a location if you give one. Adding the same event again changes nothing.
